title: Baby Creepers (RP)
description: Creepers named with "baby" are turned into small baby creepers! Using EMF. There is also a vanilla model.
body:
Baby Creepers Resource Pack
Give any Creeper a name containing "baby" to turn it into a cute baby-sized model! Requires [EMF AKA "Entity Model Features"](https://modrinth.com/project/4I1XuqiY) to display custom models correctly. There is also a vanilla model that can be aplied to an item if you want to.
simply add:

```
[minecraft:item_model="baby_creeper:items"]
```
to the give command

**This pack also works with any normal resourcepack on top of it!**
